description: This file contains source code for extension support in the libwebsockets library, including extension initialization, option parsing, callback handling, and data processing for WebSocket extensions.

methods.name: void lws_context_init_extensions(const struct lws_context_creation_info * info,struct lws_context * context)
methods.description: Initializes extensions in the libwebsockets context and logs maximum active extensions.

methods.name: int lws_ext_parse_options(const struct lws_extension * ext,struct lws * wsi,void * ext_user,const struct lws_ext_options * opts,const char * in,int len)
methods.description: Parses extension options string, matches options with known extension options, and invokes callbacks for option setting.

methods.name: int lws_ext_cb_active(struct lws * wsi,int reason,void * arg,int len)
methods.description: Calls active extensions' callback functions with a specified reason.

methods.name: int lws_ext_cb_all_exts(struct lws_context * context,struct lws * wsi,int reason,void * arg,int len)
methods.description: Invokes callback functions for all registered extensions for a given reason.

methods.name: int lws_issue_raw_ext_access(struct lws * wsi,unsigned char * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Passes data through active extensions, allowing them to modify or handle outgoing data.

methods.name: int lws_any_extension_handled(struct lws * wsi,enum lws_extension_callback_reasons r,void * v,size_t len)
methods.description: Checks if any active extension handled a specific callback reason.

methods.name: int lws_set_extension_option(struct lws * wsi,const char * ext_name,const char * opt_name,const char * opt_val)
methods.description: Sets an extension option for a particular WebSocket instance if the extension is active.
